prompts.heading: Prompt of the week
prompts.intro: A prompt shows on the hub from its start day for 7 days. Writers can still open earlier prompts with “Another prompt”.
prompts.dayHint: The first of its 7 days, in Romanian time.
prompts.empty: No prompt yet. The hub shows the card once the first one starts.
prompts.refused: Fill in both texts, up to 300 characters each, and the start day.

calls.heading: Calls for submissions
calls.intro: Calls from magazines, anthologies and competitions outside the platform. A call shows on the hub until its last day. Paid calls show to adults only.
calls.linkHint: The full address, starting with https://
calls.dayHint: The last day to send work, in Romanian time.
calls.paidLabel: The organiser pays for the work
calls.empty: No call yet. The hub shows the list once the first one is added.
calls.listLabel: Calls for submissions, latest closing day first
calls.refused: Fill in every field: titles up to 120 characters, details up to 300, and an address that starts with https://.

spotlights.heading: Writer of the week
spotlights.intro: Pick an adult writer for 7 days and say why in one line. The writer gets an invitation on the hub, and members see the card only after the writer agrees. The line can’t be changed after inviting: delete the pick and invite again.
spotlights.handleHint: The writer’s username, with or without @.
spotlights.dayHint: The card shows for 7 days from this day, in Romanian time.
spotlights.empty: No pick yet. The hub shows the card once a writer agrees.
spotlights.listLabel: Writer of the week picks, newest first
spotlights.refused: Check the username, that the writer is an adult with an active account, and both lines (up to 300 characters).
spotlights.dayTaken: Another pick already starts on that day. Pick a different day.

resources.heading: Resources
resources.intro: Know the way around: writers’ rights, step-by-step guides and where to get help.

rights.heading: Writers’ rights
rights.body: Stories stay with the people who write them. Writers keep every right to their work. We show it only where the writer chooses, and every story can be downloaded at any time.
